title: Don't Get Up Before The ALARM ⏰
description:
If your alarm rings an hour early, you don't get up. You lie still and look at the ceiling until it's light. Everybody in town knows that.

My dad is always up first anyway, sunburned in November. Then his back went out, and on Tuesday my alarm rang at five. The sun didn't come up until nine.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment FIVE if you'd have stayed in bed.
